svg.title: CubeRoot — Dreams come true.
svg.desc: CubeRoot poster with every puzzle generated directly from the SIM engine and its SVG exporters, including the center facelet emblem. Existing background, outlined lettering and composition are retained. Custom materials use the blue, lavender, pale pink and red palette of the preceding redraw.
